## Professional Summary

Builder and technical leader serving as SVP of Software Engineering at Trilogy, leading 0→1 product development across a portfolio of educational technology products. Edtech work spans three pillars: learning applications (7+ apps including AI tutoring, spaced repetition games, adaptive platforms), content generation infrastructure (curriculum modeling, AI-powered authoring, publishing workflows), and learning analytics (engagement tracking, mastery measurement, outcome correlation).

Implemented learning science principles directly: spaced repetition, mastery-based progression, automaticity building, knowledge graph-driven curricula. This enables thousands of Alpha School students to achieve 99th percentile outcomes.

Player-coach approach: combine strategic leadership ($6M budget, team of 40) with hands-on execution as product manager, architect, and full-stack engineer. Prior: 6+ years Lead Software Engineer at msg systems, SAP Developer Hero.

## Key Achievements

- Shipped 7+ learning products from concept to production spanning learning apps (TrashCat, Athena, TeachTap, TeachTales), content infrastructure (Incept), and analytics (TimeBack), implementing spaced repetition, mastery-based progression, and knowledge graph-driven curricula.
- Extended Crossover hiring platform processing hundreds of thousands of monthly visitors and tens of thousands of applications, implementing AI-powered screening and assessment grading.
- Led strategic AI adoption across organization during 2024, achieving productivity gains while industry-wide metrics declined.
- Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 50% and outages by 5x for $20M ARR SaaS product (Playbooks).

## Work Experience

### SVP of Software Engineering @ Trilogy (New Products)
*Feb 2023 - Present*

Built independent department from 6 to 40 people while scaling from 3 to 11 concurrent products, achieving 3x productivity improvement. Managing $6M/year budget with full autonomy over team structure and processes.

Education technology focus: Shipped 7+ learning products from concept to production spanning three pillars: learning apps (TrashCat, Athena, TeachTap, TeachTales, Magic Academy, ReadingCritters), content infrastructure (Incept platform for curriculum modeling, AI-powered content generation, QTI standardization), and analytics (TimeBack for student engagement tracking and outcome measurement).

Implemented learning science principles directly: spaced repetition, mastery-based progression, automaticity building, knowledge graphs for prerequisite relationships. This work enables thousands of Alpha School students to achieve 99th percentile outcomes. Also extended Crossover hiring platform and Trilogy Sales Platform.

### VP of Software Engineering @ Trilogy (Central Engineering)
*Aug 2021 - Feb 2023*

Led team of 4 to 14 engineers (grown through internal transfers) operating and extending two acquired SaaS products: InsideSales Playbooks ($20M/year ARR sales engagement platform) and ResponseTek. Focus on operational excellence and large-scale modernization of existing products.

Reduced outages by 5x and cut cloud infrastructure costs in half. Led major modernization: telephony system migration from self-hosted to serverless (Twilio), cleared defect backlog, implemented new features while maintaining production stability.
